_comment: Shared test matrix for the cross-language agreement test. Read by BOTH dashboard/lib/media-limits.test.ts and worker/tests/test_media_limits_agreement.py — a case added here is automatically covered on both sides. Every asset/expect pair below was verified against worker/media_limits.py's actual behavior against dashboard/media-limits.json as committed by Task 1; do not hand-edit an `expect` without re-checking it runs.
_coverage_note: max_width/max_height are NOT yet exercised anywhere below — no entry in dashboard/media-limits.json defines them yet, and inventing one just to test against would be a guessed limit, which this design forbids. Add too_large (dimension) cases here as soon as the first entry that defines max_width/max_height lands (expected: Instagram, Task 3, which caps width).

cases._note: ratio 400:1200 = 1:3 = 0.333, outside [9/16, 16/9] = [0.5625, 1.778] on the low side, AND width 400 < min_width 540 — deliberately trips too_small AND wrong_aspect together. Don't round to nicer numbers without re-checking both still fire.
exactly AT max_bytes — bounds are inclusive everywhere; a careless `>=` would wrongly refuse this
unknown byte_size must never refuse, same as unknown duration/width/height
